Tools.name: input_record
Tools.description: Starts a tick-zero recording or saves its validated applied inputs, expectations and state-hash checkpoints (one every 60 ticks). Stop checks output write permission. A recording with input events is first replayed with them (the verification, which replaces the play session as input.replay does): unless that run reproduces every checkpoint, the final hash and every expectation and raises no script error, Stop refuses to write it (Validation naming the first divergence, the run's outcome in error data verification), which catches a script.eval that wrote script state during the recording; the run is not torn down, so an error raised only at teardown (OnDestroy) is not counted, while test.run counts it when it plays the replay. It is then replayed without them (the input check); when that run also reproduces every checkpoint, the final hash and every expectation, whatever script errors it raises, the recording's outcome does not depend on its input and Stop refuses to write it (Validation, the check's outcome in error data inputCheck). Either way the play session is the last run's, paused where it ended. End such a recording while the played state is still in the scene. A recording without input events is written as recorded, without either run, so verify it with input.replay {verify: true, strictHash: true}.

inputSchema.title: InputRecordParams
inputSchema.description: Action-dependent recording parameters; inappropriate members are refused.

restart.description: Start only: explicitly replace an existing play session.

Tools.name: input_replay
Tools.description: Replays recorded inputs in a fresh session; verification failures retain every expectation and hash outcome in error data. strictHash compares the state hash at each checkpoint and at the final tick and stops at the first checkpoint that differs. The state hash covers the simulated world (entities and their serialized components, the tick, Random, id draws, physics), never script tables, so expectations observe script state. withoutInput replays without the input events, the check that the replay depends on its input. Afterwards the session stays paused at the replay's last tick (or where playback stopped), so script.eval, scene.query and entity.get read its final state; play.stop ends it.

inputSchema.title: InputReplayParams
inputSchema.description: Replay an asset in a fresh deterministic session.

path.description: Replay asset path, or a Runtime recording's returned user://Replays identity.

strictHash.description: Compare the recorded state hash at every checkpoint and at the final tick; requires verify. The first checkpoint that differs ends the playback there.

withoutInput.description: Apply none of the replay's input events: the check that its outcome depends on its input; requires verify. A replay whose verification still passes this way proves nothing about its input.

Tools.name: test_run
Tools.description: Runs configured tests and returns every outcome (counts, failedCases and the case rows; a replay's suite entry counts the checkpoints it compared) plus JSON/JUnit reports. The coverage object always keeps its registryFingerprint and gates; its counters are returned only with coverage: true or Testing.CoverageGates. Optional recording is published only after strict replay verification and, with input events, the input check (§13.6: refused when a run without them still passes that verification, whatever script errors it raises), and reported in the recording block (format version, ticks, events, checkpoints, final hash, where the input check diverged); a refused recording names the selected rows that did not pass. Runs play saved scene files, so test.run refuses (InvalidState, nothing run) while an open scene has unsaved changes and a selected suite or replay plays it: scene.save first.

inputSchema.title: TestRunParams
inputSchema.description: Run selected suites, cases and replays without altering authored scene state.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring of suite/case or replay path.

timeoutTicks.description: Optional positive run-wide tick cap; omitted means no additional limit.

record.description: Optional project Assets .replay output; requires one selected suite and strict reproduction in ordinary play (every state-hash checkpoint, one every 60 ticks, and the final hash). A recording with input events is also replayed without them and refused when that run reproduces every checkpoint and the final hash too, whatever script errors it raises: its outcome does not depend on its input. The result's recording block describes the replay written.

coverage.description: Return coverage.counters in the result; without it they are left out unless the project sets Testing.CoverageGates. The JSON report at jsonPath always holds them.

debugView.description: A debug view to render instead of the lit image, ignoring case: "Lit" (the default, also for ""), "Albedo", "Normals", "Roughness", "Metallic", "Emissive", "AO", "ShadowCascades" or "Overdraw". A data view stores each value v as round(255 v). ShadowCascades colours each surface by the directional shadow cascade its view distance falls in: 1 red, 2 green, 3 blue, 4 yellow, blended across the blend bands; black means no surface, no shadow-casting directional light, or beyond the shadow distance (ShadowDistance or the camera's far clip, whichever is nearer), into which the last cascade fades over the last tenth of that distance. A uniform colour over an orthographic board means it lies in one cascade, which CascadeCount 1 suits.

annotate.description: Capture-only annotations: labels=all, selection (selected), none or an EntityRef array; colliders, bounds and axes are booleans. Unknown members and invalid references are rejected.

maxDimension.description: The larger side of the PNG at most this many pixels.

inline.description: Also return the PNG as base64 in "data" when it is at most 30 KB; a larger one is only written (inlineOmitted).
